full_page.content:
Page 158 Cont.
Oct. 3rd Mrs. Burns - 60 - Arthritis in spine - injured last November .... Property for sale ....
Rose McCauley - 48 - threatened with blindness from ulcer back of eye.
Aloysius Henige - 43 - Architect - etc - but discouraged - drinking ...
Thanks - Leo Cirello - 7 - threatened with loss of Eye .... two weeks ago - tuomer disolving -- eye saved -
Oct. 11 Norman - 6 - threatened blindness
Thomas Volenti - 17 - in accident July 29 - nearly killed ... for eight years had neglected religion .... now quite determined to turn over ... asks for prayers to become strong again.
Alice Bedigere - 46 - fears loss of eye from infection
Fr. Gandentins
Page 159 Oct 9th Norman Guild - 39 - Business and finantial ...... just starting instruct- ings.
Mrs. Charlotte Lewis - Serious Eye trouble ....
Jerold Pearson - 4 - Lukemia ..... to science hopeless ... Mother Catholic - father - United church - Enrolled To-day
9th
Ann Ronan - 21 - accident - both legs broken 11th Improving.
Joseph A. Maine - 55 - Stroke a month ago. Is not Catholic though has raised his fam. such. - His father was presbiterian lived to 92 .... Went to Chicago Eucharistic Congress in hopes to see a Cardinal and die happy .. saw 11
Don. T. O'Keef - 57 yesterday - Asthma - inward cancer feared.
Mrs. Alice Fleckinger - 43 - Oldest sister very low with inward cancer - Drs. give no hope whatever of recovery.
